config.page.farming.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Farming-category quests.
config.page.fishing.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Fishing-category quests.
config.page.mining.tooltip: Master toggle and per-quest tunables for Mining-category quests.
config.page.cooking.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Cooking-category quests.
config.page.social.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Social-category quests.
config.page.festival.tooltip: Master toggle and tunables for Festival quests.
config.page.adventureBoard.tooltip: Toggle and placement for the Adventurer's Guild board near the Mine entrance.
config.consequences.tooltip: When on, certain quests can affect NPC friendships negatively.
config.festivalQuests.tooltip: Adds pre-festival quest chains in the days leading up to each festival.
config.animalQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Animal-category quest (Marnie's quests, Egg deliveries, etc).
config.farmingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Farming-category quest (crop deliveries, Pierre's stock-up, etc).
config.fishingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Fishing-category quest (fish hauls, overpopulation alerts, derby hauls, etc).
config.miningQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Mining-category quest (bar deliveries, deep dives, monster hunts).
config.foragingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Foraging-category quest (seasonal forage, plant trees, debris clearing).
config.cookingQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Cooking-category quest (saloon weeklies, grand feast, dinner party orders).
config.socialQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Social-category quest (gift deliveries, check-ins, poem inspiration).
config.seasonalQuests.tooltip: Master toggle for every Seasonal-category quest (beach cleanup, spring cleaning, heat wave relief).
config.secretGiftHint.tooltip: Adds a quest that hints at your Winter Star recipient's preferences. Disable if you'd rather not be spoiled.
config.enableAdventurersGuildBoard.toolt: When on, a custom quest board appears near the mine entrance and hosts the mining and monster quests (deep dives, slime clearing, monster eradication). When off, the guild board is hidden entirely and those quests appear on the regular help-wanted board. Per-quest weights still let you disable individual quests on top of this.
config.AdventureBoardTileX.tooltip: Tile X coordinate where the player walks to interact with the board. The board sprite renders directly above this tile. The board lives in the Mine entrance map. Default (20, 4) puts the player on the right wall, near the ladder down.
config.AdventureBoardTileY.tooltip: Tile Y coordinate of the floor the player stands on to interact. See Anchor tile X for default placement.
config.ShopDiscountPercent.tooltip: Discount applied to a shop after a fishing festival quest.
config.ShopDiscountDurationDays.tooltip: How many days the festival fishing shop discount stays active.
config.SeedShopDiscountPercent.tooltip: Discount on quested seeds at Pierre's after Pierre's Stock-Up.
config.SeedShopDiscountDurationDays.tool: How many days the seed shop discount stays active.
config.QuestCooldownShortDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'short' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling. Used by recurring board / weather / special-order quests that opt into the bucket.
config.QuestCooldownMediumDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'medium' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling.
config.QuestCooldownLongDays.tooltip: In-game days a quest in the 'long' cooldown bucket waits before re-rolling.
config.debugLogging.tooltip: Writes detailed diagnostic lines to the SMAPI log file. Off by default. Turn this on if you're chasing a bug and want to share a log; otherwise it just adds noise.
config.FishHaulMediumQty.tooltip: Catch count for medium-tier fishing hauls.
config.FishHaulLargeQty.tooltip: Catch count for expert-tier fishing hauls.
config.CropMassiveQty.tooltip: Crop count for Massive Harvest order.
config.RequestVariationCount.tooltip: How many distinct item variations NPCs ask for in mixed-bag delivery quests like Pierre's Stock-Up. Range 2 to 5. Default 3.
config.SkullCavernMaxLevel.tooltip: Maximum floor target for Skull Cavern Deep Dive quests.
config.MagicianDropRadius.tooltip: Size, in tiles, of the ritual circle for the Unseen Offering quest. Bigger circles are easier to stand inside; smaller ones are a tighter target. Mine circles cap a bit smaller since the floors are cramped.
config.WeeklySpecialComplexMinIngredient: Recipes with at least this many distinct ingredient lines qualify for the Complex saloon weekly special and Grand Feast pools.
config.CheckOnFriendsCount.tooltip: How many distinct villagers the Check on Friends quest asks you to talk to before reporting back to the giver.
config.EmilyHousewarmingCount.tooltip: How many furniture pieces you need to place in the farmhouse for Emily's Housewarming quest. Only furniture you put down while the quest is active counts, and you also need a rug, a light source, and a wall decoration among them.
For Morris's Quality Control quest, a crop only counts as cheap junk if its base sell price is under this. The default 30 fits vanilla. If you use mods that make crops worth more, raise this so there are still crops cheap enough to dump on Pierre.
config.FeedWildCrittersPerPetCredit.tool: How many Feed Wild Critters quests you have to finish before Marnie gives you a discount on your next pet. The counter resets after each discount.
config.MarniePetDiscountPercent.tooltip: How much Marnie knocks off the adoption price for every cat / dog / turtle breed once you've earned the discount. Applies to your next pet purchase, then resets to normal price.
config.MarniePetCreditExpiryDays.tooltip: In-game days the pet discount stays available before it silently expires. Unlike the chicken / cow credits, there's no gold rebate if it lapses.
config.GusFestivalFeastIngredientCount.t: Number of distinct ingredient kinds Gus's Fall and Summer festival feasts ask for.
config.FestivalBiasLuauMagnitude.tooltip: How many tiers higher the governor's Luau reaction lands when you've completed Gus's Summer prep quest. Capped at 4 (loved it). The 'not enough ingredients' line and the Mayor's Shorts gag are never overwritten.
config.FestivalBiasFairMagnitude.tooltip: Flat bonus added to your Fair grange score before judging when you've completed the Fair decor supply quest. Podium thresholds are 60, 75, and 90, so 15 lifts most submissions one place up. Only applied when 'Fair reward kind' is set to GrangeScoreBonus.
config.FairFestivalRewardKind.tooltip: Picks how the Fair decor supply quest pays you back. GrangeScoreBonus quietly adds to your grange display score before judging. StarTokens skips the bias and instead drops extra star tokens straight into your Fair pouch so you can spend them at the fair shop.
config.FairStarTokensAmount.tooltip: How many extra star tokens land in your Fair pouch when 'Fair reward kind' is set to StarTokens. Ignored when the grange bonus mode is selected.
quest.farming.basic.title: {{npc}}'s crop request
quest.farming.basic.description: Any kind farmer has some fresh {{item}}? Please bring by {{qty}} {{item}} to {{npc}} before the deadline.
quest.farming.cropCycle.title: {{npc}}'s crop cycle
quest.farming.cropCycle.description: {{npc}} wants to see a crop grown the proper way, start to finish. Sow {{qty}} {{seed}}, water them, harvest {{qty}} {{item}}, then bring the haul back. There's no rush, take the whole month if you need it.
quest.farming.cropCycle.targetMessage: Beautiful work. Hard to beat a crop grown by hand from seed to harvest.
quest.fishing.simple.title: Fresh catch needed
quest.fishing.simple.description: {{npc}} here. I saw some {{item}} splashing around the other day when I was going through {{location}}, but I couldn't catch any. Could someone bring me {{qty}}? I'd really appreciate it.
quest.mining.slime.title: Slime trouble
quest.mining.slime.description: {{npc}} here. The slimes in the mines are getting out of hand. Could a brave adventurer thin them out and report back?
quest.mining.slime.targetMessage: That'll keep the mine quiet for a while. Thanks.
quest.mining.bar.title: {{npc}} needs bars
quest.mining.bar.description: Hi, {{npc}} here. I need some {{item}} and I'm short on ores. Could someone bring me {{qty}} {{item}} before the deadline? I'll make it worth your while.
quest.mining.bar.targetMessage: These are perfect, thanks for getting them so fast.
quest.mining.archaeologyDig.title: {{npc}}'s dig request
quest.mining.archaeologyDig.description: {{npc}} is hoping someone can hunt down {{count}} artifact spots and dig them up. Keep whatever you find, and report back when you're done. They're offering {{reward}} of the {{item}} as a thank you.
quest.mining.archaeologyDig.step.dig: Find and dig up {{count}} artifact spots.
quest.mining.archaeologyDig.objective: Dig up {{count}} artifact spots, then talk to {{npc}}.
quest.mining.archaeologyDig.targetMessag: Wonderful work. Whatever you turned up should make for a great study.
quest.foraging.seasonal.title: {{npc}}'s foraging request
quest.foraging.seasonal.description: I've been looking for some {{item}} but to no luck. I really want to make some salad with them. If someone finds {{qty}} {{item}}, please bring them by. Thanks! - {{npc}}
quest.foraging.seasonal.targetMessage: Wonderful, thank you for finding these!
quest.social.elliott.title: A token of inspiration
quest.social.elliott.description: Elliott would love a {{item}} for poetic inspiration.
quest.social.elliott.targetMessage: Beautiful. This will be my muse.
quest.social.george.title: Check on George
quest.social.george.description: George has been keeping to himself more than usual lately. He would love a small thoughtful gift and some farm stories. Bring him something he likes, stop by to chat, then let me know how he's doing. - Evelyn
quest.social.george.step.gift: Bring George something he likes or loves.
quest.social.george.step.reportEvelyn: Let Evelyn know how George is doing.
quest.social.george.targetMessage: Thank you for looking in on him. He keeps saying he's fine but I know he misses his friends.
quest.redecorate.title: {{npc}} wants to redecorate
quest.redecorate.description: {{npc}} here. My place is feeling a little tired and I'd love a fresh look. I've set aside {{budget}}g for it. Could you pick out some furniture and set it up for me? Whatever you don't spend, I'll take back.
quest.redecorate.targetMessage: It looks wonderful. Thank you so much.
quest.story.morrisManOfMeans.title: A person of means
quest.story.morrisManOfMeans.description: I've had my eye on you. You've got ambition, and ambition is the one thing Joja can't manufacture. Before I bring you in on anything worth your while, I need to know you're not just another small-timer playing at business. So here's a simple test. Pull together {{gold}}g on your own, starting now. Earn that, and we'll talk about what comes next.
quest.story.morrisManOfMeans.objective: Earn money to prove yourself to Morris
quest.story.morrisQualityControl.title: Quality control
quest.story.morrisQualityControl.descrip: Good. You're exactly the kind of self-starter Joja likes. So here's the real job. Pierre loves to crow about 'fresh and local,' so let's test how local. Get your hands on the cheapest produce you can find, the sad base-quality stuff nobody really wants, and sell it straight into his shop. {{count}} pieces, nothing worth more than {{value}}g each. He'll stock it without a second look, and when folks bite into garbage with Pierre's name on it, well, that's his problem, not ours.
quest.story.morrisQualityControl.objecti: Sell cheap crops to Pierre's shop
quest.animal.hay.title: Hay supply run
quest.animal.hay.description: My hay supply is running low and I'm starting to get worried. Could you bring me some more? {{qty}} should be more than enough.
quest.animal.hay.targetMessage: Thanks! The cows were getting antsy.
quest.seasonal.beach.title: {{npc}}'s beach cleanup
quest.seasonal.beach.description: I almost hurt myself on a {{item}} the other day. Can someone pick up {{qty}} of them from the beach? You can keep them, just let me know once you've got them all. - {{npc}}
quest.seasonal.beach.targetMessage: Thanks for clearing those out. Fun to look at but not so fun to step on!
quest.collectAndReport.notEnough: That's a good start, but I was hoping for {{qty}} {{item}}. You've got {{have}} so far. Come back when you have the rest!
quest.seasonal.floraltea.title: Floral tea for {{npc}}
quest.seasonal.floraltea.description: I'd love to brew some floral tea this week. Could you bring me {{qty}} {{item}}?
quest.cooking.craving.title: {{npc}} is craving a meal
quest.cooking.craving.description: I really really REALLY want some {{item}}. Can someone make some for me?
quest.cooking.craving.targetMessage: That smells amazing. Thank you! Oh, I made some {{item2}} for dinner, here, have some!
quest.festival.submarineFuel.title: Fuel for the submarine
quest.festival.submarineFuel.description: We need backup power for the submarine during our stay in town. Last time the lights went out at low tide we lost a whole tank of squid and, it's a tragic story. Ship me {{batteries}} Battery Packs and {{coal}} Coal before the night market starts. The engine takes both.
mail.festival.submarineFuelReward.body: Dear farmer,^^She's running like new. The pearl divers found this little beauty last spring and I've been holding onto it for the right occasion. You should have it. Drop by my submarine while the Night Market is open and I can take you under the sea where you can fish some really peculiar fish.^^  -Captain
quest.festival.wizardsRitual.title: Ritual materials
quest.festival.wizardsRitual.description: The veil thins as Spirit's Eve approaches. The wards I lay each year demand fresh materials, and what I have on hand will not suffice. Place {{count}} Void Essence, {{count}} Bat Wings, and {{count}} Solar Essence in your shipping bin. They will find their way to my study by paths that need not concern you. Whether the working holds well or poorly depends on what you bring.
mail.festival.wizardsRitualReward.body: Dear farmer,^^The working held. The valley sleeps a little easier tonight - though few will know to thank you for it. As payment, an old volume from my study. I have read it more times than I care to admit, and you may yet find a use for it that escaped me.^^  -M. Rasmodius
quest.festival.holidayCookies.title: Holiday cookies
quest.festival.holidayCookies.descriptio: I'm baking holiday cookies for the festival and my pantry is bare. Could you spare {{count}} Flour, {{count}} Sugar, and {{count}} Egg? Any kind of egg will do. Bring them by when you can, there will be a warm batch waiting.
quest.festival.holidayCookies.targetMess: Thank you my dear! Here, take some of the first batch as a thank you - fresh from the oven.
quest.social.checkOnFriends.title: Check in on a few friends
quest.social.checkOnFriends.description: I haven't had time to make the rounds lately and I worry about how everyone's holding up. Could someone stop in on {{names}} and let me know how they're doing? - {{npc}}
quest.social.checkOnFriends.targetMessag: Thank you for taking the time. It really does mean a lot when someone bothers to ask.
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.title: Emily's Housewarming Challenge
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.descripti: I peeked in on your place the other day and it looked like it could use some love. A little furniture, a rug to warm the floor, a lamp or two, and something nice for the walls would liven it right up. Once it feels like a real home and not a storage closet, come find me. I asked Robin to make you something special.
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.step.ligh: Place a light source in your farmhouse (a lamp, sconce, fireplace, or torch).
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.step.rug: Place a rug in your farmhouse.
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.step.wall: Place a wall decoration in your farmhouse (a painting or window).
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.step.othe: Place other furniture in your farmhouse.
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.step.talk: Tell Emily your home is ready.
quest.social.emilyHousewarming.targetMes: Oh, it's wonderful! It feels so warm and lived-in now. Robin made you a little something to go with it. I hope you love it as much as I love what you've done with the place.
quest.festival.gusSpring.title: Gus's festival taste-test
quest.festival.gusSpring.description: Spring is finally back in the saloon kitchen and I'm planning the spread for the Egg Festival. Could you bring me {{cropCount}} {{crop}} and {{forageCount}} {{forage}} when you have the chance? I'll fix you up a sample plate as thanks.
quest.festival.gusSpring.targetMessage: Perfect, just what I needed. Here, try the {{dish}} - tell me honestly what you think.
quest.festival.gusWinter.title: Winter Star feast prep
quest.festival.gusWinter.description: The Winter Star spread won't cook itself and the pantry's looking thin. Ship {{count}} of each: {{item1}}, {{item2}}, {{item3}}. The whole town will appreciate the effort once they hear who pulled it together.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.title: Help break in the preserves jar
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.descri: Heard you finally got some Preserves Jars going. I've been wanting to stock the pantry but I never got around to making my own. Could you ship {{qty}} pickles or jams? I'll take any kind.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.object: Ship pickles or jams to the shipping bin.
quest.farming.preservesJarRequest.target: Got the haul. I already sampled some and it's delicious, thank you!
quest.farming.kegRequest.title: Kegs are running, care to share?
quest.farming.kegRequest.description: I heard you got a Keg working at the farm. I'd love to taste-test whatever's coming out of it. Drop them in the shipping bin when you're ready, no rush.
quest.farming.kegRequest.objective: Ship keg products to the shipping bin.
quest.farming.kegRequest.targetMessage: Cheers, this'll keep me happy for the season.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.title: Got a Dehydrator going?
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.descript: I noticed you picked up the Dehydrator recipe. Mind making me a batch of some dried mushrooms? I would also be happy with some raisins.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.objectiv: Ship dried mushrooms or raisins through the shipping bin.
quest.farming.dehydratorRequest.targetMe: These will last forever. Thanks for the batch!
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.title: Smoked fish for the pantry
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.descript: Willy told me you have a Fish Smoker running now. I haven't had smoked fish in ages, would you mind shipping me {{qty}}? Whenever you have time, no rush.
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.objectiv: Ship smoked fish to the shipping bin.
quest.fishing.fishSmokerRequest.targetMe: Whew! These look amazing, thank you! I can't wait to try them with some pickles.
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.title: Skull Cavern deep dive
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.descrip: The ores found beyond the deeper floors of the Skull Cavern are apparently exceptional. The Guild would like to investigate further. Mine from floor {{floor}} and ship {{count}} ores through your shipping bin. We'll be in touch.
quest.mining.skullCavernDeepDive.step.re: Reach floor {{floor}} of the Skull Cavern.
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.title: Mines deep dive
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.description: The Adventurer's Guild is paying for a deep dive into the mines. Mine floor {{floor}} and ship {{count}} ore or stone through your shipping bin. Reward comes with the morning after the haul lands.
quest.mining.minesDeepDive.step.ship: Ship {{count}} ore or stone through the bin.
mail.mining.deepDiveReward.body: Dear farmer,^^Your haul came through clean. The Guild had everything smelted overnight and ran the numbers. Here's your share of the bars - {{count}} {{bar}}, payment in full. There's plenty more work like this if you're up for it.
mail.mining.deepDiveReward.skullCavern.b: Dear farmer,^^Thanks for the ores. While smelting them, we got a few of these strange looking bars - {{count}} {{bar}} to be exact. Maybe you can find some use for them.
quest.combat.clearFloor.title: Clear the floor
quest.combat.clearFloor.description: Word is the monsters are crawling thick around {{location}}, floors {{low}} to {{high}}. Drop in and put down {{qty}} of them for me, whatever you run into down there. Just thin the ranks so the rest of us can breathe a little easier.
quest.combat.unseenOffering.title: {{npc}}'s offering
quest.combat.unseenOffering.description: A portal has opened in {{location}}. It seems the unseen ones who share the world with us mortals are restless again. Lay down some poisonous items as an offering, {{count}} should be enough to placate them before things turn hostile. Find the portal, make sure to leave the offering within its bounds, and don't linger around after you've left it. I'll be in touch.
quest.combat.unseenOffering.step: Leave {{count}} items with edibility between {{min}} and {{max}} inside the ring in {{location}}.
mail.combat.unseenOfferingReward.body: The offering was accepted.^^Whatever lingers out there is quiet again, for now. Take this with our thanks. It will give you strength when dealing with the hostile forces.
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.title: Pierre's stock-up
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.description: I'm running low on a few seasonal staples for the store. I'd like to stock up on {{count}} each of {{items}}. Bring them by the shop when you can - I'll knock the price down on the seeds for those crops in return.
quest.farming.pierresStockUp.targetMessa: Wonderful, that'll keep the shelves stocked. I've marked down the seeds for those crops as a thank you.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.title: Massive harvest request
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.description: {{npc}} from JojaMart here. Our usual supplier botched the {{item}} order, so we're stuck with empty crates and a manager breathing down our necks. We need {{qty}} {{item}} by the deadline, anything you can spare. JojaMart will pay above market for the load. A Joja representative will drop by to pick up the order from your shipping bin when it's ready.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.targetMessa: Order received. JojaMart appreciates your cooperation.
quest.farming.massiveHarvest.consequence: I heard JojaMart finally got a decent batch of {{item}} in thanks to you. Can you always be the supplier from now on? The usual stuff was always rubbish.
I think {{npc}} restocked the {{item}} just to spite me. I hate those!
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.title: {{npc}}'s weekly special
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.descr: I'm running {{dish}} as the saloon's special this week. Bring the kitchen everything on the prep list - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a stack of gold and a few happy regulars in it for you. - {{npc}}
I'm testing out a new dish at the saloon this week and the prep list is a bit of a grab bag. Bring everything on it - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a stack of gold waiting for you.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.targe: Perfect, that's the lot. Dinner service is saved.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.common.conse: I had {{npc}}'s {{dish}} this week. Honestly the best thing I've eaten all season.
{{npc}} ran {{dish}} as the special. You couldn't get me to touch that with a ten foot pole.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.complex.desc: I'm putting up an ambitious special this week - {{dish}} - and the prep list isn't small. Drop everything off at the saloon: {{ingredients}}. Bigger payday, but the kitchen needs it all by the deadline.
I'm workshopping something ambitious at the saloon this week and the prep list is a real doozy. Bring everything on it - {{ingredients}} - and there'll be a nice share of the profits waiting for you.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.complex.cons: {{npc}} had {{dish}} on special. Made my week.
The saloon served {{dish}} all week. I'm waiting for {{npc}} to take it off the menu before I set foot in there again.
quest.cooking.weeklySpecial.targetMessag: Perfect, that's everything I need for the {{dish}}. Dinner service is saved.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.title: {{npc}}'s grand feast
quest.cooking.grandFeast.text: I'm throwing a big feast at the saloon this week with {{dishes}} on the menu and I need some help with the prep list. Drop the ingredients in the shipping bin like usual and I'll handle the cooking.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.consequence.lov: {{npc}}'s feast was incredible. I had three plates of {{dish}} alone.
quest.cooking.grandFeast.consequence.hat: Oh! You're the one who supplied the ingredients for {{dish}} at {{npc}}'s feast?! I wish you convinced {{npc}} to cook something else. Such a waste of good crops.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.title: {{npc}}'s fish haul
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.description.joj: {{npc}} from JojaMart here. A shipping mishap left the Zuzu branch dry on {{item}} and the manager wants the shelves restocked yesterday. Bring in {{qty}} {{item}} - we pay on the spot.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.description.pie: READ THIS IF YOU LIKE MONEY! Zuzu's Waterpark has an urgent demand for {{item}}. Bring by {{qty}} to our Pelican Town rep and you'll earn a hefty reward.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.targetMessage: What? Oh, you read the post. Keep it down, will you? Anyways, pleasure doing business.
quest.fishing.mediumHaul.consequence.hat: I've noticed fish populations declining. Pulling {{item}} out by the cratefull for {{npc}} isn't going to help. Surely there's a more sustainable way to make money?
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.title: Seafood night at {{npc}}'s
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.description: {{npc}} is putting on a seafood night and needs a serious haul - {{qty}} {{item}} for the kitchen. The pay is well above market, but a catch this size won't go unnoticed by the folks who watch the water.
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.targetMessage: That's a hefty haul. The whole valley's eating well tonight.
quest.fishing.seafoodNight.consequence.c: I heard about the {{item}} haul for {{npc}}'s seafood night. That's the kind of catch that empties a fishing hole for months, you know.
I checked the spawn counts again this morning. {{item}} numbers are way down. We may be looking at a generational gap.
I had hoped you'd think twice before pulling that many {{item}} for one dinner service. Trust takes longer to grow back than fish do.
quest.mining.monsterParts.title: {{npc}} needs monster parts
quest.mining.monsterParts.description: {{npc}} is putting in an order for {{qty}} {{item}} - research, alchemy, or just a strong stomach, depends who you ask. Bring them by when you have the count and they'll trade you a gem worth the trip.
quest.mining.monsterParts.consequence.ha: So you're {{npc}}'s {{item}} courier now. The creatures down there have names too, you know.
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.title: Forage gifts for the valley
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.descripti: The best way to appreciate what nature gives us is to give it back to the people. Find {{count}} folks in town and gift each of them a forage they will like.
quest.foraging.forageWithLinus.step.gift: Gift loved or liked forage to {{count}} different villagers.
quest.festival.gusFall.title: Gus's Fair feast prep
quest.festival.gusFall.description: I'm putting up the saloon's spread for the Fair and the prep list isn't small. Bring me {{ingredients}} when you can. I'll fix you a sample plate, and I'll talk Lewis into giving you a few extra tickets for that prize wheel of his.
quest.festival.gusFall.targetMessage: Perfect, that's the lot. Try the {{dish}}, tell me honestly what you think. Tickets are yours too.
quest.festival.gusSummer.title: Gus's Luau potluck prep
quest.festival.gusSummer.description: The Luau soup is more than I can prep alone this year. Bring me {{ingredients}} when you can. Whatever you contribute makes it into the pot, and I'll make sure to put in a good word for you with the governor.
quest.festival.gusSummer.targetMessage: That'll do it. Try the {{dish}}, tell me honestly what you think. Whatever the soup tastes like at the Luau, you're the reason it tastes that way.
quest.social.giftDelivery.title: A small gift for {{recipient}}
quest.social.giftDelivery.description: I overheard {{recipient}} craving some {{item}} the other day. Maybe you could get them one and make their day?
quest.social.giftDelivery.targetMessage: Oh! Thank you. That's so thoughtful.
quest.social.guntherMuseum.title: A piece for the museum
quest.social.guntherMuseum.description: I've been short on new finds lately. If you could spare just one item the museum doesn't already have, I'd be happy to give you one of our spare display pieces as a thank you. Come find me once you've made the donation.
quest.social.guntherMuseum.step.donate: Donate any item to the museum.
quest.social.guntherMuseum.step.report: Speak to Gunther to collect your reward.
quest.social.guntherMuseum.targetMessage: Wonderful! Here's that display piece I promised. Thank you again.
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.title: {{npc}}'s heat wave relief
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.descriptio: The clinic is full of folks half-fainted from the heat. {{npc}} is asking for {{qty}} {{item}} to keep around for anyone who comes in dehydrated. Drop them off when you can and there's something for the trouble.
quest.seasonal.heatWaveRelief.targetMess: Perfect. That'll keep the valley upright through the next hot spell.
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.title: Notes for the Moonlight Jellies
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.descriptio: I'm pulling together some field notes ahead of the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies and could use a few specimens from the beach. Could you bring me {{qty}} {{item}} sometime in the next few days?
quest.seasonal.jellyfishWatch.targetMess: These are exactly what I needed. Thanks for indulging the field work.
quest.festival.merchantUnpacking.title: Night Market seeds for {{npc}}
quest.festival.merchantUnpacking.descrip: I won't make it to the night market but I need to stock up on some seeds. Can you get some for me? I need {{qty}} of each of these {{varietyCount}} kinds: {{items}}. Ship them through the bin once you've picked them up and I'll owe you one.
quest.mining.monsterHunt.title: Monster bounty
quest.mining.monsterHunt.description: {{npc}} here. I've got a stack of complaints from townsfolk about monsters near the trails. {{qty}} kills should clear the worst of it, type doesn't matter. Stop by when you've thinned the numbers and there's a hot meal waiting.
quest.mining.monsterHunt.targetMessage: Good work. Take this with you, you'll need it for the next run.
quest.foraging.rareForage.title: {{npc}}'s rare forage
quest.foraging.rareForage.description: {{npc}} has heard rumours of {{item}} turning up in the area and wants {{qty}} of them. Bring what you can find, no rush. There'll be coin and seed packets in it for the trouble.
quest.foraging.rareForage.targetMessage: These are the real deal. Thank you for chasing them down.
quest.mining.rareMaterial.title: {{npc}}'s rare material request
quest.mining.rareMaterial.description: {{npc}} here. I need some {{item}}, and I can't venture out to get them myself. If you can bring me {{qty}} of them, I'll make it worth your while.
quest.mining.rareMaterial.targetMessage: These will do nicely. Thanks for getting them for me.
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.title: A whisper for the Winter Star
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.descriptio: I think {{recipient}} is going through a tough time this winter. Maybe a thoughtful gift would cheer them up. I heard they love {{item}}!
quest.festival.secretGiftHint.step: Give {{recipient}} a {{item}} or something they like during the Festival of the Winter Star.
quest.festival.wrappingPaper.title: Wrapping paper for the festival
quest.festival.wrappingPaper.description: Folks have put in orders for wrapping paper ahead of the gift giving festivities. Please ship {{count}} papers and tapes before the deadline. I have a nice book I can give you as thanks.
quest.farming.qualityCrop.title: {{npc}}'s quality crop order
quest.farming.qualityCrop.description: I'm putting together a particular meal and only the best {{item}} will do. Please bring {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}} when you have them. Anything less and it just won't taste right.
quest.farming.qualityCrop.targetMessage: These look perfect! Thank you for taking the extra care.
quest.farming.premiumCrop.title: {{npc}}'s premium order
quest.farming.premiumCrop.description: I am willing to pay a premium for {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}}. Bring them by when you have the lot.
quest.farming.premiumCrop.targetMessage: Spectacular! The quality of your produce is unmatched. Thank you!
quest.fishing.qualityFish.title: {{npc}}'s quality fish order
quest.fishing.qualityFish.description: The waters have been bleak these past few days and I need some quality fish. Can someone catch {{qty}} {{quality}} {{item}} and bring them by? I will pay a premium for the catch, but anything less than {{quality}} just won't do.
quest.fishing.knowYourWaters.title: Know your waters: {{location}}
quest.fishing.knowYourWaters.description: A real angler knows every fish in their water. Reckon you can pull one of each kind that swims at {{location}} this season? The whole lot, nothing skipped. Bring proof you've caught them all and come find me, and I'll know you've truly earned the title round here.
quest.fishing.knowYourWaters.report.ques: You sure have come a long way since you first picked up that flimsy little beginner rod! Tell me, which fish was the hardest to catch?
quest.fishing.knowYourWaters.report.opti: I'm a professional. There's no such thing as "hard to catch".
I lost a few on the line, honestly. It gave me a real respect for your trade.
It was awful. Please don't ask me to do that again.
quest.fishing.knowYourWaters.report.repl: Ha! Confident, aren't you! Well, the catch speaks for itself. Here, this is for you.
Now that's the right attitude. Most folks never stop to feel it. Take this, and this too, you've earned them.
Hah! Honest to a fault. That's exactly why you stuck it out, though. Here, take these. You've more than earned them.
quest.festival.moonlightJellies.title: Lights for the Moonlight Jellies
quest.festival.moonlightJellies.descript: Lewis here. I'm decking the pier out for the Dance of the Moonlight Jellies and could use a hand. Ship {{torches}} torches and {{wood}} wood through the bin and I'll see something nice gets sent your way.
quest.festival.eggFestivalDecor.title: Hay for the Egg Festival
quest.festival.eggFestivalDecor.descript: Farmer, I need your help decorating the town for the upcoming Egg festival. The rest of the townsfolk have helped out a ton, I just need a few haybales to complete the look. Ship me {{count}} when you can. P.S. Marnie keeps hay bales in stock at the ranch if you're short. The town will reimburse you.
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.title: The kids' big plan
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.descripti: Vincent and Jas have decided that Abigail wins the Egg Hunt every single year and someone has to put a stop to it. That someone, apparently, is you. Talk to the other kids to keep everyone in on the secret, then go beat Abigail at her own game when the hunt starts.
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.offer: @! @! Listen. Me and Jas have this whole plan. Abigail wins the Egg Hunt every year and it's NOT FAIR. So this year, you're going to win for us. Pretty please? Go tell Jas you're in, and don't say a word to the grown-ups.
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.step.win: Win the Egg Hunt on Spring 13.
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.reward.fr: The kids will be over the moon if you actually pull this off.
Remember the plan, @! We can't let Abigail win this year. She always hoards the eggs and we never get a turn.
Did Vincent tell you the plan, @? Keep it quiet, alright? This is a secret between us. You're going to win, right? Right?!
I heard about the plan. I am SO ready to see Abigail's face when she loses. Go go go, @!
@, you know all the best hiding spots, right? I bet there's one inside Dusty's house. Abigail ALWAYS checks the saloon first. You need to be faster!!
Psst, @. Don't tell grown ups about the plan, okay? This is TOP secret!
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.hud.lost: The kids look heartbroken. You let Abigail win again...
quest.festival.eggHuntSabotage.hud.eggDe: The kids dropped off a fancy egg at the farm this morning.
mail.festival.eggHuntSabotageReward.body: Dear @,^^You did it!! You really did it!!^^We all pitched in our allowance and got Marnie to sell us the fanciest egg she had. Look outside, we left it on your porch this morning. We promise it's not a prank.^^Thanks for sticking it to Abigail. She was SO MAD.
quest.festival.dyeForEggs.title: Dye for the Egg Festival
quest.festival.dyeForEggs.description: Farmer, Emily, Leah and Elliot are helping me paint the eggs for the Egg Festival and they complained that the current dye options are - in their words - 'insulting'. If you can, please provide {{countPer}} items in each of these {{colorCount}} colors so we can mix proper paints: {{colors}}. Get them in before festival day and I'll send a little something I had Robin help me put together.
item.eggBasket.cream.name: Cream Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.cream.description: A hand-woven basket lined with pale cream cloth. Robin says she's seen better baskets at the Fair, but Lewis insists this one has character.
item.eggBasket.pink.name: Pink Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.pink.description: A soft pink basket trimmed with ribbon. Looks like it could hold a dozen freshly painted eggs without losing a single one.
item.eggBasket.rustic.name: Rustic Egg Basket
item.eggBasket.rustic.description: A sturdy brown basket made from hardwood splints. The kind of thing you'd grab on the way out to gather eggs at dawn.
quest.festival.fairDecor.title: Fair grounds preparation
quest.festival.fairDecor.description: Farmer, could you spare {{flowers}} fall flowers, {{wood}} wood, and {{signs}} signs for the upcoming Fair decorations? I will remember your favor when judging the grange displays... Any kind of sign works (wood, stone, or dark).
quest.festival.luauDecor.title: Luau setup
quest.festival.luauDecor.description: Farmer, I've outpaced the Luau decor budget and I need your help. Ship {{fiber}} fiber, {{hardwood}} hardwood, and {{lamps}} lamps and I'll get Pierre to send you something from his Luau shop stock as a thank you. The wood lamp-posts are craftable, Robin sells the recipes.
quest.festival.spiritsEveDecor.title: Spirit's Eve atmosphere
quest.festival.spiritsEveDecor.descripti: Farmer. Spirit's Eve approaches, and the maze this year asks for a deeper touch than the Mayor's usual fare. Send me {{pumpkinSeeds}} pumpkin seeds for the patch I'm coaxing along the edges, {{cloth}} cloth for the shrouds, and {{torches}} torches to mark the path. I have a rarecrow set aside for you in return.
quest.festival.esvSpiritsEve.title: An East Scarp Spirit's Eve
quest.festival.esvSpiritsEve.description: Rosa's hosting an East Scarp Spirit's Eve gathering and the theme is sp00ky and witchy. Ship {{purple}} purple-coloured items, {{slime}} slime, and {{stone}} stone. The attendees will appreciate it.
quest.festival.rsvGathering.title: Ridgeside Gathering setup
quest.festival.rsvGathering.description: {{farmer}}! I need to dress up the town square for the upcoming gathering and ran short of some stuff. Could you ship {{tubs}} Tub o' Flowers, {{wood}} wood, and {{tables}} tables before the gathering? I'll give you due credit and I'm sure everyone would appreciate you more for helping out. P.S. I snagged this instruction manual for the tubs from Pierre the other day. Robin usually has a few tables in her rotation at the carpenter's shop if you're short.
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.title: Trouble at {{location}}
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.descriptio: {{npc}} here. The population of {{item}} at {{location}} is way past balanced and the rest of the food web is feeling it. Pull {{qty}} from there and we'll be in better shape.
quest.fishing.locationOverpop.targetMess: Thanks. The numbers should settle now.
quest.fishing.rainyDay.title: Catches that hide in the rain
quest.fishing.rainyDay.description: These ones only bite when it's pouring, and the forecast's finally on our side. If you can land {{qty}} {{item}} while the rain's coming down, I'll thank you with a tackle I found the other day.
quest.fishing.rainyDay.targetMessage: Lovely catch. Rain or shine, you've got the touch!
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.title: Thinning the {{bucket}} catches
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.description.sm: The smaller fishes have been growing in alarming numbers and eating away at the algae and growth along the stream bed. Reduce their numbers before they cause any more harm. Bring back {{qty}} catches under {{maxSize}} inches.
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.description.pr: The number of {{bucket}} fish have been growing in alarming rates lately and the smaller fish are struggling to survive. We need to reduce their numbers before the ecosystem collapses. Pull {{qty}} catches measuring at least {{minSize}} inches.
quest.fishing.sizeOverpop.targetMessage: Good. The numbers should settle now.
quest.fishing.legendary.title: Tale of the {{item}}
quest.fishing.legendary.description: Hear me out, friend. Old fisher's tale says a {{item}} has been spotted again, and not many folks alive have ever held one. If you've got the patience and the gear, see if you can land one and bring it back to me. There's a worthy haul of bait waiting if you do.
quest.fishing.legendary.targetMessage: I knew you had it in you. That's a story worth telling.
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.title: Rainbow Platter for the Trout Derby
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.descriptio: Farmer! The annual trout derby is coming up and I want to put out some specials at the saloon. Bring in {{qty}} Rainbow Trouts while the event is ongoing and I'll cut you in on the recipe for {{dish}} and a discount!
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.objective: Catch {{qty}} Rainbow Trout during the Trout Derby.
quest.festival.rainbowPlatter.targetMess: Beautiful catch. The platter's going to look incredible.
quest.festival.squidFest.title: Showcase dish for SquidFest
quest.festival.squidFest.description: With SquidFest coming up, I'm doing a showcase and I would need {{qty}} squid for the feast. I'll teach you the recipe for {{recipe}} and there will be a discount for the dish at my place just for you as thanks.
quest.festival.squidFest.targetMessage: Perfect. SquidFest is going to be a hit.
quest.animal.alexProtein.title: Protein for the home gym
quest.animal.alexProtein.description: Hey, I'm trying to bulk and Marnie can't seem to keep up with my protein needs. Bring me {{qty}} eggs and I'll cut you in on whatever supplement bottle I've got open. Cheers.
quest.animal.alexProtein.targetMessage: Solid. That's the lot. Here, take this with you.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.title: Specimen for the museum
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.description: I heard a rumor a Dinosaur Egg surfaced on your land. Could you bring it by the museum? I'd love a closer look, and I'd return it safe and sound back to you. There'll be a fair price for the loan.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.objective: Bring a Dinosaur Egg to Gunther.
quest.animal.guntherDinosaur.targetMessa: Farmer, thanks for letting me examine this incredible specimen. It turned out to be even better quality than I originally thought! Returning it to you with my thanks.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.title: A note from the sewers
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.description: A void egg has found you. The little ones of the dark do not come to just anyone. Bring it to me at the sewers. I have something for you in return, something worth more than the egg.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.objective: Bring a Void Egg to Krobus.
quest.animal.krobusVoidNote.targetMessag: Yes. Yes, this one is healthy. Take this book. It will help you understand what walks beneath the valley.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.title: Leah wants to paint your animals
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.descriptio: I've been itching to paint something with a bit more life in it than my blueprints of sculptures. Bring one of your animals over to my place sometime soon, would you? I'd love some inspiration, and Marnie's cows refuse to stand still long enough for me to get a good look. I'll let you have a copy of the painting if it comes out nice.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.step.visit: Walk into Leah's house with at least one animal following you.
quest.animal.leahFarmPainting.targetMess: My goodness, look at that face! Thank you.
mail.animal.leahFarmPainting.body: Hey @,^^The painting from your visit is all done. I had fun with this one, hope it brightens up a wall.^^  -Leah
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.title: Show your animals around town
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.descrip: That deluxe barn of yours seems to be getting along great. Take a couple of your animals on a walk into Pelican Town when the weather's nice. The neighbors love seeing healthy livestock around the square, and I'd love hearing back about it.
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.step.wa: Walk into Pelican Town with at least two animals following you.
quest.animal.marnieLivestockShow.targetM: Look at them, parading around like champions. Everyone's been talking about it. I owe you for that.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.title: Marnie's chicken offer
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.descript: I heard you got a new coop! The ranch just got a fresh batch of baby chicks and I'll be glad to give one to you in exchange for some Mixed Seeds.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.targetMe: Thank you! Stop by the ranch when you're ready and your first chick is on me.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.creditIs: Marnie's holding a free chick for you. Pick one up from her shop within {{days}} days.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.creditRe: Enjoy your new chick. Marnie's covered it.
quest.animal.marnieChickenOffer.creditEx: You didn't visit Marnie in time. She sent over {{gold}}g instead.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.title: Marnie's cow offer
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.description: Heard you got a barn up. Animals love to go for walks around town for a change in scenery and you can do that with a {{item}}. Pick up a {{item}} from my shop and I'll set you up with a cow on the house.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.descriptionB: Heard you got a barn up. You'll need a {{item}} to actually get milk out of a cow. Pick one up from my shop and I'll set you up with a cow on the house.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.objective: Buy a {{item}} from Marnie's shop and bring it to her.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.targetMessag: Good. Swing by the ranch when you've got space in your barn and your first cow's on me.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.creditIssued: Marnie's holding a free cow for you. Pick one up from her shop within {{days}} days.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.creditRedeem: Enjoy your new cow. Marnie's covered it.
quest.animal.marnieCowOffer.creditExpire: You didn't visit Marnie in time. She sent over {{gold}}g instead.
quest.animal.marnie.menuRefreshed: Marnie's shop needs to refresh after the freebie. Open it again to keep shopping.
quest.animal.marnieEgg.title: First eggs for Marnie
quest.animal.marnieEgg.description: Congratulations on your first eggs! If you can spare {{qty}} of them through the shipping bin, I'd love to send a Mayonnaise Machine recipe your way and pay the going rate. The hens will give you plenty more.
quest.animal.marnieEgg.targetMessage: Lovely. The recipe is on its way.
quest.animal.marnieMilk.title: First milk for Marnie
quest.animal.marnieMilk.description: Your cow's producing! If you can ship me {{qty}} milk through the bin, I'll send back a Cheese Press recipe so you can start turning that milk into something with a longer shelf life. There'll be coin too, of course.
quest.animal.marnieMilk.targetMessage: Wonderful, that's the lot. Cheese press recipe in the post.
quest.animal.robinSilo.title: Robin's silo offer
quest.animal.robinSilo.description: Now that I've got your new building squared away, I was thinking you really ought to have a silo to go with it before that hay starts piling up. The recipe needs {{stoneQty}} stone, {{clayQty}} clay, and {{copperQty}} copper bars. Here's the deal: if you can bring me any one of those, I'll comp the rest of the materials and the labor myself. Just bring me a stack of stone, clay or the copper bars, whichever's easiest for you. Then swing by the shop whenever you're ready and you can put a silo up wherever you like on the farm, on the house.
quest.animal.robinSilo.objective: Bring Robin {{stoneQty}} Stone, {{clayQty}} Clay, or {{copperQty}} Copper Bars.
quest.animal.robinSilo.targetMessage: Perfect. Come by the shop whenever you're ready to pick out a spot. The silo's on the house.
quest.animal.robinSilo.voucher: Robin is offering a free silo build. Visit the carpenter shop.
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.title: Caroline's tea garden
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.descript: I'm putting together a fresh batch of tea and could really use {{qty}} {{item}}. If you've got some on hand (or know someone who does), drop them off and I'll send you home with plenty of tea leaves to brew with.
quest.farming.carolineTeaGarden.targetMe: Wonderful! These are going straight in the kettle. Take some tea leaves, you've earned them.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.title: Help clear the debris
quest.foraging.clearDebris.description: I would appreciate a hand tidying up around the valley. Could you clear out {{count}} of the logs, boulders, or stumps? Anywhere off the farm is fair game, it all helps.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.objective: Clear debris anywhere off the farm.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.step: Clear debris anywhere off the farm.
quest.foraging.clearDebris.targetMessage: Looks much better already. Thanks for pitching in.
quest.foraging.feedWildCritters.title: Feed the wild critters!!
quest.foraging.feedWildCritters.descript: I saw a hungry little animal in the forest yesterday and I felt so bad for it. Could you bring {{count}} {{item}} to the forest and leave them on the ground? The critters will come eat them, I just know it!!
quest.foraging.feedWildCritters.targetMe: You really did it! Maybe now the critters won't be so hungry anymore. Thank you!!
quest.foraging.feedWildCritters.creditIs: Marnie heard you've been feeding the wild critters. She's offering {{percent}}% off your next pet at her shop, for the next {{days}} days.
quest.foraging.feedWildCritters.creditRe: Marnie's wild-critters discount has been applied!
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.title: {{npc}}'s dinner party
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.description: {{npc}} is hosting a small dinner party and wants the night catered. Cook {{count}} of each of these and bring them over: {{dishes}}.
quest.cooking.dinnerParty.targetMessage: These look incredible. My guests are going to be thrilled. Here's a little something for your trouble.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.title: Plant some trees
quest.foraging.plantTrees.description: The valley's tree cover is looking a bit sparse. Plant {{count}} new trees anywhere outside the farm and I'll be in your debt.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.objective: Plant {{count}} trees anywhere outside the farm.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.step: Plant {{count}} trees anywhere outside the farm.
quest.foraging.plantTrees.targetMessage: Beautiful work. The forest will thank you for years.
quest.seasonal.battenDown.title: Batten down the hatches
quest.seasonal.battenDown.description: Big storm rolling in soon by the look of that sky. If you keep animals and crops out in the open, you'll want lightning rods up before it hits, at least {{count}} of them. Far better a rod takes the strike than your barn roof or your best tree.
quest.seasonal.battenDown.objective: Put up {{count}} lightning rods on the farm before the storm.
quest.seasonal.battenDown.step: Place {{count}} lightning rods on the farm.
quest.seasonal.battenDown.targetMessage: Good. Let the sky do its worst now, the farm's ready for it.
mail.seasonal.battenDownReward.body: Glad you got those rods up in time. I have no use for this, it's better in your hands. Stay dry out there.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.title: Spring cleaning
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.descriptio: The weeds are getting out of hand and it's an eyesore. If someone could get rid of {{count}} weeds around town, I would be very grateful.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.objective: Clear weeds from anywhere but the farm.
quest.seasonal.springCleaning.targetMess: Much tidier. Thanks for taking the time!
config.LeahPaintingFrame.tooltip: Which frame Leah uses on the painting she sends you. The painting itself is always a surprise, only the frame is your choice.
